title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: TikTok ships Ads MCP server + Ads Skills — big-four ad platforms now all agent-callable
bullets.summary: TikTok becomes the last of Google/Meta/Amazon to expose an MCP layer so your own agents plan, launch, and optimize ad campaigns; companion 'Ads Skills' are workflow building blocks. Announced at TikTok World May 12-13; not yet GA.
bullets.how: Maps to Brand 9 Signs paid acquisition + PRAGMA operator wedge: one Construct campaign-ops agent driving all four ad-platform MCPs.

bullets.title: Anthropic: connector observability dashboard + enterprise-managed MCP (Okta) + in-app directory submission
bullets.summary: Admins provision MCP connectors org-wide via Okta with zero-touch first-login access; a public-beta dashboard tracks adoption, errors, latency, and per-tool calls across Claude / Claude Code / Cowork; devs submit connectors to the directory in-app.
bullets.how: Real observability over The Construct's MCP fleet and a clean path to publish our internal servers.

bullets.title: OpenAI GPT-5.6 'Sol' — 91.9% Terminal-Bench 2.1; access restored to vetted US orgs Jun 27
bullets.summary: Sol is OpenAI's strongest coding/agentic model yet (91.9% Terminal-Bench 2.1) at GPT-5.5 pricing ($5/$30 per 1M); access partially restored to vetted US orgs on June 27 after a government preview process.
bullets.how: Benchmark our coding/computer-use agents against Sol once access clears; watch the export-control overhang.

bullets.title: Google Gemini 3.5 Pro reaches GA in late June — reasoning tier above 3.5 Flash
bullets.summary: Pro closes the reasoning gap Flash regressed on; Flash is already the default in the Gemini app and AI Mode at $1.50/$9.00 per 1M.
bullets.how: Flash for cheap high-volume batch text/image, Pro for reasoning-heavy Construct jobs — a clean cost/quality split.

bullets.title: arXiv: 'Agent Skills for LLMs — Architecture, Acquisition, Security'
bullets.summary: Frames capability extension as three paradigms: prompt engineering (2022-23), tool use / function calling (2023-24), skill engineering (2025-present), with a dedicated treatment of skill security and acquisition.
bullets.how: Framework for our daily/weekly new-skills scan and installed-skills registry — treat skills as governed, security-reviewed assets, not loose prompts.

praxis_lesson: Every major ad platform — Google, Meta, Amazon, now TikTok — has shipped an MCP layer, so agentic campaign ops is becoming table stakes rather than an edge. The Construct's move for Brand 9 Signs / PRAGMA is to wrap all four ad-platform MCP servers behind one operator agent that plans, launches, and optimizes across channels — owning the orchestration layer, not any single platform.
